Class CalendarControllerTest

  • java.lang.Object
    • CalendarControllerTest
  • public class CalendarControllerTest
extends java.lang.Object
    Unit tests for the CalendarController class. This class contains test cases to verify the correct behavior of the methods in ICalendarController, including input handling, event management, and calendar status checks.
